infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Connekyt uses your camera to take a selfie for finding your event photos, scan the pairing code on your TV, record video messages, and broadcast your event live.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Connekyt uses your microphone to carry sound when you broadcast your event live and when you record a video message.
